description: Defines the Composite class for dynamic shape management and the Nil singleton class for representing null-like dynamic objects within OrchardCore's display management system.

classes.name: Composite
classes.description: A dynamic object representing a composite shape with flexible property and index access, supporting property assignment, retrieval, and method invocation.

classes.name: Nil
classes.description: A singleton class representing a null-like dynamic object, used to signify absence or null values in dynamic contexts.

methods.name: Composite.TryGetMember
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a property value by name.

methods.name: Composite.TryGetMemberImpl
methods.description: Implementation for getting a property value internally.

methods.name: Composite.TrySetMember
methods.description: Attempts to set a property value by name.

methods.name: Composite.TrySetMemberImpl
methods.description: Implementation for setting a property value internally.

methods.name: Composite.TryInvokeMember
methods.description: Handles method calls, including property assignment and special handling for ToString.

methods.name: Composite.TryGetIndexImpl
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by index (string key).

methods.name: Composite.TryGetIndex
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a value by index, supporting string keys.

methods.name: Composite.TrySetIndex
methods.description: Attempts to set a value by index, supporting string keys.

methods.name: Nil.TryGetMember
methods.description: Always returns the singleton instance for any member.

methods.name: Nil.TryGetIndex
methods.description: Always returns the singleton instance for any index.

methods.name: Nil.TryInvokeMember
methods.description: Always returns the singleton instance for any method invocation.

methods.name: Nil.TryBinaryOperation
methods.description: Handles equality and inequality operations with the singleton instance.

methods.name: Nil.Equals
methods.description: Checks reference equality with the singleton instance.
